## What problem does this solve?

A clear description of the problem or limitation you ran into. What were you
trying to do, and what got in the way?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to happen? Describe the feature or change as concretely as
you can.

## Where does it fit in the flow?

Which part of the migration does this touch? (Check all that apply.)

- [ ] Upload / connecting YNAB
- [ ] Reviewing and selecting accounts
- [ ] Naming accounts / setting types and subtypes
- [ ] Manual CSV download
- [ ] Mapping accounts, columns, categories, or tags
- [ ] Import priority / duplicate handling
- [ ] The import itself (creating accounts, uploading transactions)
- [ ] The completion / thank-you experience
- [ ] Something else (describe below)

## Alternatives you've considered

Any other approaches or workarounds you've thought about or are using today.

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, links, or anything else that helps explain the request.
If it's relevant, roughly how many accounts/transactions you were migrating.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and this hasn't already been requested
- [ ] This is a feature request (use the bug report flow for things that are broken)
